sources.label: Lazzari et al. — SLC2A1 variants and GLUT1 trafficking (2026)

research.summary: A white horse rests in a station waiting room while a traveller watches the empty platform. In a human brain endothelial cell model, selected SLC2A1 missense variants changed the intracellular distribution of tagged GLUT1: some accumulated in lysosome-related compartments, while another favored Golgi and early endosomes. The study highlights intracellular location as a complement to transport measurements. Published in Molecular Medicine, 29 July 2026.

title: The Passenger Who Stayed · 留下的旅客
